name: IBM 726 magnetic tape unit
summary: The IBM 726 was a magnetic tape drive sold with IBM's 701 computer, using vacuum columns to buffer the tape so data could be read and written quickly.
description: IBM 726 vacuum-column magnetic tape reader and recorder supplied for IBM 701 electronic computers.
